items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: All I know, my mother's told me that she... She went to Tom Lafond School and her oldest brother had a German teacher to teach her music.

ctx.x: Well, you know quite a bit about your family, how far back it goes. Well... I guess I can answer some things. Yeah. Were your grandparents musical? Anybody, you know? Your mother's father or mother's mother?
All I know, my mother's told me that she... She went to Tom Lafond School and her oldest brother had a German teacher to teach her music. Oh yeah.

Well the Germans made good community teachers in this country. Yeah. I heard about them anyway. Yeah. All over the country. They were. But Tom Lafond School where? Six and Ferret. But she lived here then. And you were born up there. My mother... Look, you see, Downsville is only 65 miles. Yeah. My mother was sent down there to her oldest brother. Her oldest brother raised her when she was a young girl. I see.
